tasks.title: Government Headquarter Hospital Blood Camp Support & Triage
tasks.description: Assist medical officers with queue management, voluntary blood donor hydration, and recovery monitoring.

tasks.title: Old City Riverfront Promenade Cleanliness & Plastic Segregation
tasks.description: Conduct awareness on clean heritage walkways and clean plastic wraps along public pilgrimage and river ghats.

tasks.title: Heritage Monument Cleanliness & Public Heritage Awareness
tasks.description: Conduct a public cleanliness campaign around historic monuments and guide visitors on waste segregation practices.

tasks.title: Mega Blood Donation Camp Donor Registration & Refreshment Management
tasks.description: Manage voluntary donor registration, pre-donation medical history slips, and coordinate donor refreshment tables.

tasks.title: Rockfort Heritage Temple Cleanliness & Pilgrim Guidance Drive
tasks.description: Assist elderly devotees ascending temple stone steps, distribute drinking water, and guide pilgrims on plastic-free temple grounds.

tasks.title: Government Hospital Patient Navigation & Wheelchair Escort
tasks.description: Assist elderly and disabled outpatients with hospital navigation, wheelchair guidance, and registration counter procedures.

tasks.title: Public Library Book Cataloging & Blind Student Audio Recording
tasks.description: Digitally index 500 donated regional textbooks and record crisp audiobook chapters for visually impaired students.

tasks.title: Monsoon Waterlogging Relief & Sandbag Embankment Reinforcement
tasks.description: Fill and deploy heavy sandbags along overflowing irrigation canals to protect agrarian settlements from flash floods.

tasks.title: Brahmaputra Flash Flood Medical Kit Assembly & Water Purification
tasks.description: Pack 500 family water purification kits, chlorine drops, and zinc tablets for displaced river-island families.

tasks.title: Winter Extreme Cold Blanket & Thermal Wear Distribution
tasks.description: Distribute 300 heavy woolen blankets and sweaters to nighttime pavement occupants and nomadic rickshaw pullers.
tasks.location: Jaipur Railway Station & Night Shelter Environs

tasks.title: Riverbank Inundation Family Hygiene Kit Packaging Drive
tasks.description: Package antiseptic soaps, sanitary napkins, ORS sachets, and bandages into sealed dry packs for flood-prone rural blocks.
tasks.location: Red Cross Relief Warehouse, Fraser Road

tasks.title: Cyclone Shelter Readiness & Emergency First Aid Station Setup
tasks.description: Equip public coastal storm shelters with solar lanterns, emergency medication, and water canister distribution desks.

tasks.title: Urban Flood First Aid & Emergency Dry Ration Packaging
tasks.description: Sort, inspect, and crate 400 family dry ration packages, mosquito nets, and first-aid kits for flood-hit settlements.

tasks.title: Emergency Flood Relief Kit Assembly & Logistic Packing
tasks.description: Sort and pack emergency water purification tablets, high-energy dry rations, and waterproof tarpaulins for low-lying coastal colonies.

tasks.title: Community Eye Checkup & Spectacle Distribution Camp for Seniors
tasks.description: Guide senior citizens through visual acuity chart screening, register OPD slips, and dispense reading spectacles.
tasks.location: Utkal Community Welfare Hall, Saheed Nagar

tasks.title: Assisted Grocery Shopping & Pharmacy Walks for Bedridden Seniors
tasks.description: Support independent elderly couples with home delivery of monthly prescription medicines and bank paperwork.

tasks.title: Palliative Care Recreational Day & Memory Games for Elders
tasks.description: Conduct guided memory recall exercises, simple chair yoga sessions, and listen to life stories of senior hospice inmates.
tasks.location: St. Joseph Palliative Care Hospice, Ernakulam

tasks.title: Health Vital Checkup Assistance & Mobility Support for Seniors
tasks.description: Assist visiting physicians with pulse oximeter readings, blood pressure logs, and escorting infirm elders to exam rooms.
tasks.location: Karunai Illam Old Age Home, Katpadi

tasks.title: Storytelling, Board Games & Musical Evening with Elderly Residents
tasks.description: Engage senior citizens with interactive carrom matches, Rabindra Sangeet sing-alongs, and empathetic listening sessions.
tasks.location: Shanti Old Age Home, Salt Lake

tasks.title: Senior Citizen Digital Literacy & Smartphone Assistance Camp
tasks.description: Provide gentle one-on-one assistance to 40 senior residents on UPI digital payments, video calls, and medicine ordering.

tasks.title: Geriatric Recreation, Newspaper Reading & Companionship Circle
tasks.description: Spend an uplifting evening with 35 senior residents in an old age home reading Tamil classics and playing memory games.

tasks.title: Ganga Ghat Cleanliness Drive & Plastic Interception
tasks.description: Deploy floating waste nets and manually clean plastic offerings and floral debris along public riverside ghats.
tasks.location: Assi Ghat to Dashashwamedh Ghat Stretch

tasks.title: Sukhna Lake Eco-Zone Plastic Removal & Awareness Drive
tasks.description: Collect non-biodegradable bottles and chip wrappers along forest walking trails and advise morning joggers on zero-litter policies.

tasks.title: Mula-Mutha Riverbank Cleaning & Native Sapling Plantation
tasks.description: Remove solid plastic debris, clear weeds, and plant 300 drought-tolerant native saplings along the riverbank.

tasks.title: Tamirabarani River Ghat Cleaning & Seed Ball Dispersion
tasks.description: Clean sacred bathing ghats along the Tamirabarani river and disperse 600 seed balls along deforested river banks.

tasks.title: Mangrove Restoration & Shoreline Plastic Cleanup
tasks.description: Clear plastic waste trapped in coastal mangrove roots and plant 250 mangrove saplings to protect creek shorelines.

tasks.title: Warm Meal Assembly & Delivery for Daily Wage Laborers
tasks.description: Pack and distribute 300 hot thali lunch boxes to daily wage construction workers and sanitation laborers.

tasks.title: Midday Community Meal Langar Preparation & Service
tasks.description: Assist in cutting vegetables, kneading flour, and serving community meals to 500 pilgrims and homeless visitors.

tasks.title: Night Street Feeder Drive for Homeless Families
tasks.description: Conduct an organized late-evening mobile food van drive supplying ready-to-eat hot meal packets to homeless families.

tasks.title: Coastal Cleanup & Marine Microplastic Removal Drive
tasks.description: Collect, document, and safely segregate non-biodegradable debris and ghost nets from sandy nesting zones.

tasks.title: Noyyal Riverbank Desilting & Miyawaki Afforestation Drive
tasks.description: Plant 400 native saplings along the Noyyal riverbank and remove discarded plastic bottles from canal embankments.

tasks.title: Free Food Ration Packing for Destitute Widows & Daily Wagers
tasks.description: Sort and bag dry grocery essentials (rice, dal, cooking oil, spices) into monthly relief hampers for 120 families.

tasks.title: Nutritious Khichdi Meal Distribution at Slum Clusters
tasks.description: Assemble and transport warm vegetable khichdi pots to provide wholesome mid-day meals to slum children.

tasks.title: Sunday Morning Nutritious Breakfast Drive for Pavement Dwellers
tasks.description: Cook, assemble, and distribute 350 warm idli-sambar and fruit boxes to destitute individuals near bus terminals.

tasks.title: Weekend Surplus Food Packaging & Slum Distribution
tasks.description: Package surplus banquet meals and safely distribute nutritious food packets to 200 migrant worker families.
tasks.location: Rashtra Seva Community Kitchen, Barakhamba Road

tasks.title: Rural Youth Career Guidance & Spoken English Mentorship
tasks.description: Deliver career planning sessions, resume writing workshops, and basic spoken English to high school graduates.

tasks.title: Foundational Hindi & English Reading Circle for Slum Kids
tasks.description: Facilitate storybook reading circles and basic vocabulary games for first-generation school learners.

tasks.title: Foundational English & Math Workshop for Textile Mill Children
tasks.description: Mentor children of textile weavers in conversational English, mathematical tables, and reading fluency.

tasks.title: Primary School Science Experiments & Interactive STEM Lab
tasks.description: Demonstrate hands-on physics and chemistry experiments for municipal middle school students to spark curiosity in science.

tasks.title: Digital Literacy & Computer Basics for Slum Youth
tasks.description: Teach keyboarding, email drafting, and online government portal navigation to college-bound youth from informal settlements.

tasks.title: Spoken English & Basic Math Tutoring for Children
tasks.description: Conduct interactive learning sessions for 30 underprivileged primary students to strengthen foundational literacy and numeracy.

tasks.title: Remedial Evening Coaching for Coastal Children
tasks.description: Assist primary school children of local fisherman families with daily homework, Tamil, and arithmetic lessons.
